fact: On 18 April 2024 the Minister announced a multilingual LLM built by Awarri with NITDA and DataDotOrg, and a pilot national compute with over $2 million of GPUs funded by 21st Century Technologies at Galaxy Backbone, open to local researchers and startups.
title: Dr. Tijani Wraps Up Artificial Intelligence Strategy Workshop; Announces Groundbreaking Partnerships with Cisco, 21st Century Technologies, others
publisher: Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation & Digital Economy
